title.zh: 将三宝颜锡布格省 Payao 市镇 Balungisan 描笼涯的 Payao 国立中学的 Balungisan 附属校分离，改设为独立的同名国立中学，并为此拨款
title.en: An Act Separating the Payao National High School - Balungisan Annex in Barangay Balungisan, Municipality of Payao, Province of Zamboanga Sibugay from the Payao National High School, Converting it into an Independent National High School to Be Known as Balungisan National High School and Appropriating Funds therefor
title.orig: An Act Separating the Payao National High School - Balungisan Annex in Barangay Balungisan, Municipality of Payao, Province of Zamboanga Sibugay from the Payao National High School, Converting it into an Independent National High School to Be Known as Balungisan National High School and Appropriating Funds therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật tách Phân hiệu Balungisan của Trường Trung học Payao Quốc gia tại Barangay Balungisan, Đô thị Payao, Tỉnh Zamboanga Sibugay khỏi Trường Trung học Payao Quốc gia và chuyển thành Trường Trung học Độc lập Quốc gia với tên gọi Trường Trung học Balungisan Quốc gia, và bố trí kinh phí
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติแยกวิทยาเขต Balungisan ของโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Payao แห่งชาติในบารังไกย์ Balungisan เทศบาล Payao จังหวัด Zamboanga Sibugay ออกจากโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Payao แห่งชาติและยกฐานะเป็นโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาเอกเทศแห่งชาติชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Balungisan แห่งชาติ และจัดสรรงบประมาณ
title.id: Undang-Undang Memisahkan Kampus Balungisan, Sekolah Menengah Payao Nasional di Barangay Balungisan, Kotamadya Payao, Provinsi Zamboanga Sibugay dari Sekolah Menengah Payao Nasional dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Mandiri Nasional dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Balungisan Nasional, dan mengalokasikan dana
title.ms: Akta Memisahkan Kampus Balungisan, Sekolah Menengah Payao Kebangsaan di Barangay Balungisan, Perbandaran Payao, Wilayah Zamboanga Sibugay daripada Sekolah Menengah Payao Kebangsaan dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Bebas Kebangsaan dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Balungisan Kebangsaan, dan memperuntukkan dana

text.en: Separation and Conversion into a National High School. - The Payao National High School - Balungisan Annex in Barangay Balungisan, Municipality of Payao, Province of Zamboanga Sibugay is hereby separated from the Payao National High School and converted into an independent national high school to be known as Balungisan National High School.

Transfer of Assets and Liabilities. - All personnel, assets, liabilities and records of the Payao National High School - Balungisan Annex are hereby transferred to and absorbed by the Balungisan National High School.

Appropriations. - The Secretary of Education shall immediately include in the Department’s program the operationalization of the Balungisan National High School, the initial funding of which shall be charged against the current year's appropriations of the Payao National High School - Balungisan Annex. Thereafter, the amount necessary for the continued operation of the school shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
Implementation. - The Secretary of Education shall issue rules and regulations that may be necessary to carry out the purpose of this Act.
Effectivity. - This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette.
